---
name: Workflow experience
about: Report an installation, modelling or repair experience
---

## Task and environment

Workshop version, OS, Python, Blender, agent/model if used, target engine and intended asset.

## Steps and result

What did you try? Include the command, expected result, actual result and relevant output.

## Effort

Approximate setup, modelling, repair and review time. What saved time or caused extra work? Was this your first use?

## Reproduction

Attach a minimal generator/spec or link a project you are allowed to share. Remove secrets and private artwork. State the reference permissions. For visual issues, include actual exported-model views and relevant poses.
